scope: Read Japanese premises and complete11-turn exchanges plus each of12 locale sentence/task sets. No cross-worker review. Source/profile issues remain separate.
reviewCriteria: Salary receiving account versus sending money to employer; preserve sender/recipient, account-information submission versus bank deciding payday; do not mark undeposited pay received.
Duplicate-looking food packages: check product names, sizes, quantities and family stock; preserve before-checkout status and staff handling of unwanted item.
Prior fall does not establish all current paths unsafe, sunshine does not establish safety; current route information, short route and stopping when worried.
Long instrument case: upright handling limits view, step aside for following passengers, backpack leaves hands available; wait for staff and rotate only in spacious place.

Disaster announcements: preserve only hearing end of broadcast and no known warning target; separate text notification registration/area setting from querying actual announcement. Vietnamese nghe lỡ replaced with natural phrase không nghe được.
Exercise after consultation: reception must collect question rather than make clinical decision; preserve need for possible reassessment and separate question from response method.
Video-clock discrepancy: no precise seconds correspondence, keep original file and distinguish shortened excerpt; never edit evidence to appear accurate.
Reused envelope: distinguish old address and new intended department, lifted cover paper; Chinese corrected physical putting an envelope inside another envelope to discontinuing postage use.
Personal phone alarm: preserve stopping sound versus disabling five-minute repeat; can still hear counter call. Vietnamese/Khmer nearby people clarified, Chinese wait-until-turn phrasing corrected.
Food donation: purchase precedes donating and eligibility must be checked; Chinese recycling-box terminology corrected to food donation box, keep one donation can separate from dinner items.

Community language support: distinguish everyday bilingual communication from all-document/professional translation, no guessing unknown technical or medical content, define supervision and scope before acceptance; afternoons off are proposed availability, not a settled appointment.
